Z7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
'Fetchable' means a database exists whose records would populate the field. It does
not mean the fetched values would be correct, or useful, or that the resulting model
would predict anything better. Loop 188b is the cautionary case: the epigenetic
layer was fetched in full and added nothing over measured binding.
The EC split treats an exact 4-level match as 'already modelled'. Two enzymes sharing
an EC number catalyse the same chemistry on possibly different substrates in
different compartments, so some of that count is optimistic.
The motif family bound uses UniProt domain NAME equality. Real family inference uses
binding-domain sequence similarity, which is both stricter and more permissive than
string matching in ways this cannot quantify.
Publication counts come from the gene table and measure attention, not knowledge. A
gene with four papers that solved it is not unknown; a gene with forty that
contradict each other is.
Nothing here was fetched, so nothing here is validated. Every number is a promise
about what a fetch would find, and the next loop's job is to collect on one of them
and report the difference.
